rationale: C21 is a plausible material drafting source because it is an earlier letter to the same congressional recipients transmitting agricultural legislation and develops the same linked policy logic: aligning production with need, protecting farm income, reducing surpluses and storage burdens, and avoiding harm to consumers. The child broadens this framework from an emergency feed-grain measure to a comprehensive farm bill. C04 and C22 share the transmittal-and-prior-message structure, but mostly at the level of routine legislative-letter language and lack C21's distinctive agricultural policy content.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Transmitted herewith, for consideration by the Congress, is a draft of a bill which would carry out the principal recommendations set forth in my message to the Congress on March 16, 1961.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am transmitting herewith a bill to provide a special program for feed grains for 1961.
shared_material.explanation: Both open by transmitting agricultural legislation to Congress, with C21 supplying the same basic letter structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: It will enable the farmer, in cooperation with the government, to adjust his production to meet our domestic needs and our international commitments for food and fiber.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: We need to shift our production from commodities of which there is an unmanageable surplus to commodities for which there is a need, even as we curtail our production of those surplus commodities.
shared_material.explanation: Both frame agricultural legislation as machinery for adjusting production away from surplus and toward actual needs.

shared_material.child_excerpt: It is directed toward assuring that the farmer has an opportunity to achieve an income comparable to that enjoyed by other segments of our economy
shared_material.parent_excerpt: our over-all goal to use our agricultural abundance to meet the needs of our people, and at the same time provide a fair income for those who produce that abundance.
shared_material.explanation: The child reuses C21's coupling of productive abundance and consumer need with protection of farmer income.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The programs established under the legislation should gradually reduce the burden imposed by large storage costs and high surpluses.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: a saving of several hundred million dollars of Government funds; and ... a holding down or reduction of surplus stocks to more manageable proportions. This will be done without any material effect upon consumer prices.
shared_material.explanation: The same triad of surplus reduction, lower governmental/storage burdens, and consumer protection appears in both directives.
